name: rapier-engine
description: Object-oriented 2D game engine built on Rapier physics

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --external @dimforge/rapier2d-compat && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
